meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需加载既定工作模式指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在高强度任务前让助手进入既定工作模式。
copy.tagline_en: Load the preset working-mode directive when needed.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to follow a preset directive when you need intense focus.

howto.what: 开启后,Claude 会先声明“ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”,再按严格编码流程工作:先写会失败的测试,再实现,并在真实界面验证成果,全程记录笔记和计划。
howto.when: 当你明确要求开启“ultrawork 模式”(如“进入 ultrawork”“启用 ultrawork”等),且当前对话还没有这份指令时触发。

say.text: 进入 ultrawork 模式,修复这个登录问题。
say.note: Claude 会先写失败测试再修复并验证。

say.text: 启用 ultrawork,把这个新功能按测试先行的方式做出来。
say.note: 会先看到失败,再实现到通过并记录过程。

say.text: 使用 ultrawork,认真验证这次的页面改动。
say.note: 会在真实浏览器检查并保存证据。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude first prints 'ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!' then follows a strict coding workflow: write failing tests, implement, verify on the real surface, and keep a notepad of plans and findings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask to enable 'ultrawork mode' (e.g., 'enter ultrawork', 'turn on ultrawork') and this directive is not already in the conversation.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork mode and fix this login issue.
say_en.note: Writes a failing test first, then fixes and verifies.

say_en.text: Enable ultrawork and build this feature test-first.
say_en.note: Sees it fail first, then implements to pass and logs.

say_en.text: Use ultrawork mode to thoroughly verify this page change.
say_en.note: Checks in a real browser and saves evidence.
